name: ha-home-panel
description: A wall-tablet and phone dashboard for Home Assistant, installed as a custom sidebar panel

scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npm run test:visual
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npm run test:visual -- --update-snapshots=all
scripts.test:visual:container: container run --rm --init -c 4 -m 4g -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npm run test:visual
scripts.test:visual:update:container: container run --rm --init -c 4 -m 4g -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npm run test:visual -- --update-snapshots=all
scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && prettier --write package.json README.md examples/configuration.yaml
